# Space Designer 3D

> > A comprehensive 2D/3D floor planning and space design platform for individuals, professionals, and enterprises with support for multiple export formats and collaborative workflows.

Space Designer 3D is a web-based architectural design tool that enables users to create detailed floor plans and 3D visualizations for residential, commercial, and educational projects. The platform serves diverse user segments from individual designers to enterprise organizations, with features including BIM interoperability, design templates, and team collaboration capabilities.

## Key Topics

- 3D floor plan software
- Space planning
- Interior design
- Residential design
- Enterprise solution
- 2D/3D design
- Home design
- Design software
- Floor plan templates
- BIM interoperability
- Export formats (PNG, JPG, PDF, DXF, GLTF, OBJ)
- Team collaboration
- Subscription-based pricing
- Educational accounts
- Commercial design

- [Free Floor Plan Layouts - Space Designer 3D](https://www.spacedesigner3d.com/floor-plans): Free customizable floor plan templates for apartments, houses, and offices.
- [Featured | Space Designer 3D](https://www.spacedesigner3d.com/gallery/featured): Showcase of diverse design projects including residential and commercial spaces.
